title: Few hits, mostly misses
text: More misses than hits.  My year subscription is almost over and the toys have been a mixed bag.  Too many toys that you put treats in (especially to hold bully sticks), and too few "fun" toys.  There were a few hits, but most my dog doesn't care for.  Shipping delays have been constant.  I am not renewing and regret subscribing.  I can pick out better toys on my own.
label: negative
